task: put the gear in the carrier and put a pin in it
image_resize: Fixed centered square 480x480 crop (80,0,560,480) for every camera, then Pillow LANCZOS resize to 256x256; recorded inference contract preserved.
sampling: Regular 50ms active data-clock grid using data_monotonic_ns when present, otherwise host monotonic_ns; nearest measured state and camera frame within each human-only interval; ties select earlier samples. No interpolation or synthetic states. Repeated camera frames are counted per episode.
action_semantics: absolute measured left joints 1..6, left gripper rad, right joints 1..6, right gripper rad at the NEXT grid tick (t+0.05s). Kinesthetic next-pose proxy, not sent motor commands. Final observation is omitted if its next state would leave the crop.
state_semantics: measured left joints 1..6, left gripper rad, right joints 1..6, right gripper rad. Both joint and gripper values remain native radians.
camera_assignment: Wrist-to-arm assignments are unverified; preserve USB-port names rather than inventing left/right labels.
timing: Camera and state alignment uses the active recording data clock; camera data_monotonic_ns maps host receive timestamps into that clock. Original host monotonic_ns timestamps and actual data-clock alignment offsets are preserved. Timestamps are host receive times, not hardware exposure timestamps.
trim_method: All human-owned contiguous intervals; split at recording pauses; conservative camera coverage edge trims; no visual success filtering
